question: How do I reference a specific example named "ExampleWithMarkley" when using the EndpointRequestSnippet component?
ground_truth: To reference a specific example named "ExampleWithMarkley" when using the EndpointRequestSnippet component, first set the example name in your spec, then use the example prop like this: `<EndpointRequestSnippet endpoint="PUT /pet" example="ExampleWithMarkley" />`. If the example includes a summary or docs field, use that for the example prop instead of the example name.
